modules.name: HoloSuite Core
modules.summary: The GM-facing launcher module that connects HoloSuite modules.
installation: In Foundry's Setup screen, open Add-on Modules > Install Module, search for HoloSuite Core, and click Install.
Launch your world as a GM. Open Game Settings > Manage Modules, check HoloSuite Core, and save.
Install the other HoloSuite modules you want through the same installer, then enable them in Manage Modules.
Open the launcher from the button in the token-controls and click a module's button to open it.

modules.name: CyberCall
modules.summary: Make calls or send messages to players & npc's
installation: In Foundry's Setup screen, open Add-on Modules > Install Module, search for CyberCall, and click Install. Install HoloSuite Core here too if you do not have it.
Launch your world as a GM. Open Game Settings > Manage Modules, enable HoloSuite Core and CyberCall, and save.
Open CyberCall from the HoloSuite launcher.
Use the composer to prepare a call or open contacts to manage call targets.
Broadcast calls to players or let players initiate calls to the GM.

modules.name: Security Cameras
modules.summary: Show players camera feeds taken from live Scene regions or static images.
installation: In Foundry's Setup screen, open Add-on Modules > Install Module, search for Security Cameras, and click Install. Install HoloSuite Core here too if you do not have it.
Launch your world as a GM. Open Game Settings > Manage Modules, enable HoloSuite Core and Security Cameras, and save.
Open the Camera Manager from the HoloSuite launcher.
Create a camera and choose the current scene or a static image source.
Save the camera, then use Show to Players during a session.

modules.name: CSI Toolkit
modules.summary: Shared case boards for evidence, suspects, locations, timelines, and theories.
installation: In Foundry's Setup screen, open Add-on Modules > Install Module, search for Crime Scene Investigation Toolkit, and click Install. Install HoloSuite Core here too if you do not have it.
Launch your world as a GM. Open Game Settings > Manage Modules, enable HoloSuite Core and Crime Scene Investigation Toolkit, and save.
Open the Case Manager from the HoloSuite launcher.
Create a case with title, subtitle, description, visibility, and board theme.
Add cards and connections as the investigation develops.

modules.name: Galaxy Map
modules.summary: Build a holographic star map with systems, routes, travel, and GM-controlled reveals.
installation: In Foundry's Setup screen, open Add-on Modules > Install Module, search for Galaxy Map, and click Install. Install HoloSuite Core here too if you do not have it.
Launch your world as a GM. Open Game Settings > Manage Modules, enable HoloSuite Core and Galaxy Map, and save.
Open Map Manager from the HoloSuite launcher.
Create a new map or import existing JSON.
Open the map and start adding systems and routes.

modules.name: Bounty Board
modules.summary: Post contracts for players to browse, claim, and complete from a sci-fi job board.
installation: In Foundry's Setup screen, open Add-on Modules > Install Module, search for Bounty Board, and click Install. Install HoloSuite Core here too if you do not have it.
Launch your world as a GM. Open Game Settings > Manage Modules, enable HoloSuite Core and Bounty Board, and save.
Open Bounty Board from the HoloSuite launcher.
Create contracts with the details players need.
Post or update jobs as the campaign moves through hubs and factions.

modules.name: Critical Cut-In
modules.summary: Play full-screen character animations for critical rolls.
installation: In Foundry's Setup screen, open Add-on Modules > Install Module, search for HoloSuite Critical Cut-In, and click Install. Install HoloSuite Core here too if you do not have it.
Launch your world as a GM. Open Game Settings > Manage Modules, enable HoloSuite Core and HoloSuite Critical Cut-In, and save.
Open Configure Settings and find the module settings.
Set the default trigger threshold.
Open Configure Player Cut-Ins to customize actors.

modules.name: HoloSuite Hacking
modules.summary: Interactive hacking minigames where Foundry skill checks shape puzzle difficulty.
installation: In Foundry's Setup screen, open Add-on Modules > Install Module, search for HoloSuite Hacking, and click Install. Install HoloSuite Core here too if you do not have it.
Launch your world as a GM. Open Game Settings > Manage Modules, enable HoloSuite Core and HoloSuite Hacking, and save.
Open the hacking launcher from the HoloSuite launcher.
Choose minigame, actor, owning player, skill, and DC.
Send the challenge and let the player accept.

modules.name: HoloDock
modules.summary: Manage ship loadouts, equipment, power, and damage without tying them to one game system.
installation: In Foundry's Setup screen, open Add-on Modules > Install Module, search for HoloDock, and click Install. Install HoloSuite Core here too if you do not have it.
Launch your world as a GM. Open Game Settings > Manage Modules, enable HoloSuite Core and HoloDock, and save.
Open HoloDock from the HoloSuite launcher.
Create a ship profile, then add stats and equipment slots to match your campaign's vehicle rules.

modules.name: HoloSuite Vending Machines
modules.summary: Region-linked vending machines with limited stock, baskets, actor currency, and four terminal styles.
installation: In Foundry's Setup screen, open Add-on Modules > Install Module, search for HoloSuite Vending Machines, and click Install. Install HoloSuite Core here too if you do not have it.
Launch your world as a GM. Open Game Settings > Manage Modules, enable HoloSuite Core and HoloSuite Vending Machines, and save.
Open Configure Settings, find HoloSuite Vending Machines, and open the machine manager.
Create a machine, drag in products, set prices and stock, then link any Scene Regions that should provide access.

modules.name: HoloSuite Blueprint
modules.summary: Build, annotate, present, publish, and export tactical blueprints from Foundry Scenes.
installation: Subscribe to my Mage Tower Studios Patreon at a tier that includes the premium modules.
On the Foundry VTT website, sign in to the account that owns the license used by your server. Link your subscribed Patreon account in your profile.
Check Subscribed Content in your Foundry profile. If your access is missing, refresh the Patreon link and check your subscription tier.
In Foundry's Setup screen, open Add-on Modules > Install Module. Find HoloSuite Blueprint under Premium Content and click Install. Install HoloSuite Core here too if you do not have it.
Launch your world as a GM. Open Game Settings > Manage Modules, enable HoloSuite Core and HoloSuite Blueprint, and save.
Activate the Scene that will anchor the facility.
Open Blueprint from HoloSuite Core or the Scene Controls button.

modules.name: HoloSuite Terminal
modules.summary: Create in-world computers with mail, files, cameras, utilities, downloads, and hacking.
installation: Subscribe to my Mage Tower Studios Patreon at a tier that includes the premium modules.
On the Foundry VTT website, sign in to the account that owns the license used by your server. Link your subscribed Patreon account in your profile.
Check Subscribed Content in your Foundry profile. If your access is missing, refresh the Patreon link and check your subscription tier.
In Foundry's Setup screen, open Add-on Modules > Install Module. Find HoloSuite Terminal under Premium Content and click Install. Install HoloSuite Core here too if you do not have it.
Launch your world as a GM. Open Game Settings > Manage Modules, enable HoloSuite Core and HoloSuite Terminal, and save.
Optionally enable HoloSuite Hacking for minigames and Security Cameras for linked live feeds.
Open Terminal from the HoloSuite launcher or the module settings menu.
